# Green View Rarău

> A modern A-frame cabin for rent at the foot of Rarău mountain, in Bucovina,
> Suceava county, Romania. Built with natural materials, a panoramic skylight,
> a stone fireplace and direct access to the forest.

## Facts

- Type: A-frame holiday cabin (self-catering), rented whole
- Location: Rarău – Pojorâta area, Bucovina, Suceava county, Romania
- Coordinates: 47.488536, 25.571363
- Capacity: groups of 8–16 guests
- Layout: 6 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, fully equipped kitchen
- Heating: central heating plus a wood-burning stone fireplace (firewood included)
- Amenities: high-speed Wi-Fi, panoramic terrace, private on-site parking,
  espresso machine, garden hammock, direct forest access
- Minimum stay: 2 nights
- Booking: pick dates on the site, request sent via WhatsApp (+40 756 651 582);
  availability confirmed within ~2 hours
- Guest ratings (as of 2026-10-02): 4.9/5 on Google (22 reviews); 10/10 on Turistinfo
  (13 reviews, https://www.turistinfo.ro/campulung_moldovenesc/cazare-campulung_moldovenesc/casa_de_vacanta_green_view_rarau/reviews-casa_de_vacanta_green_view_rarau-c119345.html)
- Languages: Romanian and English

## Nearby (by road, from the Pojorâta / Câmpulung Moldovenesc area)

- Pietrele Doamnei rock towers — ~9 km
- Rarău peak — a few minutes by car
- Transrarău scenic road — ~12 km
- Rarău ski slope — ~12 km
- Moara Dracului Gorge — ~18 km
- Wood Art Museum, Câmpulung Moldovenesc — ~18 km
- Slătioara UNESCO old-growth forest — ~22 km
- Pojorâta village (nearest shops) — ~6 km
- Moldovița narrow-gauge tourist train — ~42 km
